title: Betulinic acid induces lysosome-dependent death in prostate cancer by targeting DDX5.
authors: Liu, Shoushi; Li, Xiaolan; Cheng, Zhiping; Zhao, Kaili; Wang, Yanting; Wei, Yuhe; Wang, Yuanshuo; Lu, Jinjian; Yang, Xin; Lim, Yang Mooi; Lu, Qinpei; Huang, Qiuju; Guo, Hongwei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桦木酸通过靶向DDX5诱导前列腺癌细胞溶酶体依赖性死亡，属于药物靶点与细胞死亡机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Prostate cancer (PCa) represents a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in men. Betulinic acid (BA) exhibits antitumor properties. However, its direct molecular target and mechanism in PCa remain unclear. PURPOSE: To identify BA's molecular target and elucidate its mechanism in inhibiting PCa progression. STUDY DESIGN: In vitro and in vivo models were employed to evaluate BA's antitumor effects and underlying mechanisms. METHODS: BA's antitumor activity was assessed in PCa cell lines and xenograft models. Apoptosis was examined via Hoechst staining, flow cytometry, and terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase-mediated dUTP nick-end labeling (TUNEL) assay. Lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP) was examined via LysoTracker Red and acridine orange (AO) staining, validated by CA074-Me. Target identification utilized pull-down assays, drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS), molecular docking, and microscale thermophoresis (MST). Clinical data analysis and siRNA knockdown confirmed DDX5's role. RESULTS: BA significantly suppressed PCa growth in vitro and in vivo without toxicity. BA directly bound DDX5, inhibiting transcription factor EB (TFEB)-mediated lysosomal biogenesis and downregulating V-ATPase subunit H (ATP6V1H), essential for lysosomal acidification. This disruption induced LMP and lysosome-dependent cell death (LDCD) via apoptosis, confirmed by CA074-Me. DDX5 expression was decreased in PCa tissues. DDX5 knockdown abolished BA-induced LDCD and lysosomal dysfunction. CONCLUSION: BA directly targets DDX5, inducing LDCD through the novel BA-DDX5-TFEB-ATP6V1H axis, exploiting lysosomal vulnerability in PCa. These findings underscore BA's therapeutic potential and propose lysosomal membrane destabilization as a precision treatment strategy for PCa.
abstract_zh: 背景：前列腺癌（PCa）是男性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。白桦脂酸（BA）具有抗肿瘤特性。然而，其在PCa中的直接分子靶点及机制尚不明确。目的：鉴定BA的分子靶点，并阐明其抑制PCa进展的机制。研究设计：采用体外和体内模型评估BA的抗肿瘤效应及其潜在机制。方法：在PCa细胞系和异种移植模型中评估BA的抗肿瘤活性。通过Hoechst染色、流式细胞术和末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶介导的dUTP缺口末端标记（TUNEL）实验检测细胞凋亡。通过LysoTracker Red和吖啶橙（AO）染色检测溶酶体膜透化（LMP），并用CA074-Me进行验证。靶点鉴定采用pull-down实验、药物亲和响应靶点稳定性（DARTS）、分子对接和微量热泳动（MST）技术。临床数据分析和siRNA敲低实验确认了DDX5的作用。结果：BA在体外和体内显著抑制PCa生长，且无毒性。BA直接结合DDX5，抑制转录因子EB（TFEB）介导的溶酶体生物发生，并下调对溶酶体酸化至关重要的V-ATP酶亚基H（ATP6V1H）。这种干扰通过凋亡诱导LMP和溶酶体依赖性细胞死亡（LDCD），并经CA074-Me验证。DDX5表达在PCa组织中降低。DDX5敲低消除了BA诱导的LDCD和溶酶体功能障碍。结论：BA直接靶向DDX5，通过新型BA-DDX5-TFEB-ATP6V1H轴诱导LDCD，利用PCa中的溶酶体脆弱性。这些发现强调了BA的治疗潜力，并提出将溶酶体膜失稳作为PCa的精准治疗策略。
